original.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, the `fluxcd/flux2/action` GitHub Action finds the latest Flux version without calling the GitHub API.

decision.reason: [ev-a884587f873c] says that `fluxcd/flux2/action` now determines the latest version without using the GitHub API. The configuration stays the same and only the method changes, so behavior-changed is the right type. The text names the component `fluxcd/flux2/action`. The name "latest-version-determination" is short kebab-case built from the evidence's own words.
